title: Portfolio dashboard by product, delinquency bucket and total overdue

scope_out: must not trigger or depend on the end-of-day job, per D11; must not report a fee, penalty or collections figure; must not be reachable with a CUSTOMER session

entities.name: Portfolio dashboard by product, delinquency bucket and total overdue

operations.text:
1. Define the `PortfolioSummary` value object (by-product, by-bucket loan count and value, and `total_overdue`) and `PortfolioRepository.summary() -> PortfolioSummary` in `backend/src/repository/delinquency/portfolio_repository.py` (new): aggregate loan count and value per `product_code` and `delinquency_bucket` from the stored `loan.outstanding_principal` and `loan.delinquency_bucket` projections (maintained by E11-S2), and sum the overdue installment amounts across active loans for `total_overdue` — a read-only query, with no write and no call to the end-of-day run.
2. Define `portfolio_summary() -> PortfolioSummary` in `backend/src/service/delinquency/portfolio.py` (new): delegate to `PortfolioRepository.summary()` only; this is the single call path and it never invokes `delinquency.run_end_of_day` (owned by E12-S1), per D11.
3. Define `GET /dashboard` in `backend/src/api/delinquency/portfolio_routes.py` (new): enforce `require_roles(ADMIN)` (owned by E1-S2) so a `CUSTOMER` session receives 403 with no portfolio figures in the body, then call `portfolio_summary()` and return the `by_product`/`by_bucket` breakdown, `total_overdue` and `as_of`.
4. Register `portfolio_routes.router` in the app factory `backend/src/api/app.py` (owned by E15-S1) via one `include_router` call.
5. Append one endpoint row for `GET /dashboard` to the read-heavy endpoint registry `backend/tests/slo/registry.py` (owned by E15-S3) so the dashboard read surface meets the SLO budget.
6. Add `getPortfolio()` to `frontend/src/api/dashboard.ts` (new), calling the shared HTTP client from `frontend/src/api/client.ts` (owned by E1-S1) against `GET /dashboard`.
7. Define the `Portfolio` screen in `frontend/src/ui/pages/Portfolio.tsx` (new): an admin-only surface that fetches via `getPortfolio`, renders the per-product, per-bucket loan count and value breakdown, and renders `total_overdue` using `MoneyText` (owned by E9-S1); render no fee, penalty or collections figure anywhere on the screen (SG-1).
8. Add one route entry for `Portfolio` to the frontend route registry `frontend/src/ui/routes.tsx` (owned by E1-S1), gated to the `ADMIN` role via the role-to-landing-surface map (owned by E1-S1).
9. This story's bundle owns no dedicated test file; verify AC1-AC4 against `backend/src/api/delinquency/portfolio_routes.py` and `frontend/src/ui/pages/Portfolio.tsx` through the e2e test matrix (VM-098–VM-101): per-product-and-bucket count and value (AC1), `total_overdue` reconciling to the sum of overdue installment amounts (AC2), 403 with no figures for a `CUSTOMER` session (AC3), and figures traced to stored bucket state with no end-of-day invocation (AC4).
